tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// dpal 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ kā li tsakra sūrya wa sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ gsal byed nyi ma'i 'khor los dbang du bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub pa pos snod bcud dbang du bya bar 'dod pas/ rang nyid khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sku mdog li khri'i phung po ltar dmar la yum bde ba rgyas byed ma dang gnyis su med par bltas te/ sngags 'di bya khwa ta'i skad mi grags pa'i dus la padma'i phreng ba 'dzin pas bzlas par bya'o// oṃ shāntiṃ ka ri ṇi bhrūṃ/ oṃ ku su ma ma li bhi hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badzra ku sa dzi kai bhi ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ oṃ gro ge ma kṛ te/ sarba sha trūṃ nan/ ka kā dha ya kā dha ya/ kha khā hi khā hi/ ga gādzdza ya gādzdza ya/ gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ tsa tsā la ya tsā la ya/ tsha tshā da ya tshā da ya/ dza dzaṃ bha ya dzaṃ bha ya/ dzha dzha ta ya dzha ta ya/ ṭa ṭā la ya ṭā la ya/ ṭha ṭhā ka ya ṭhā ka ya/ ḍa ḍā bha ya ḍā bha ya/ ḍha ḍha ka ya ḍha ka ya/ ṇa ṇā sha ya ṇā sha ya/ ta tāṃ bha ya tāṃ bha ya/ tha tho bha ya tho bha ya/ da dā ta ya dā da ya/ dha dhā ra ya dhā ra ya/ na nā sha ya nā sha ya/ pa pā ta ya pā ta ya/ pha phā ta ya phā ta ya/ ba bandha ya bandha ya/ bha bhe ta ya bhe ta ya/ ma mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ya yo ha ya yo ha ya/ ra ro ha ya ro ha ya/ la lo ba ya lo ba ya/ wa wa ha ya wa ha ya/ sha sho sha ya sho sha ya/ ṣa ṣuṣṭi ya ṣuṣṭi ya/ sa sā dha ya sā dha ya/ ha ha na ya ha na ya/ kṣa kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya/ a mu ke ṣye kṛ te/ shāntiṃ ku ru/ puṣṭiṃ ku ru/ kṣa ma ku ru kṣo bhaṃ ku ru/ mā raṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ siddhi/ sarba siddhi/ ma hā siddhi/ pū dza agne taṃ/ bhna te ma ra ṇaṃ/ 'di'i cho ga ni shing shun la/ dang po'i sngags gsum nang du bri/ gru bzhi pa la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i phyi rol tu bri'o// de nas mu khyud bzhi'i yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi sngags rim pas bris/

thams cad g.yon skor du'o// mā ra ya btags nas gtor ma dmar po byin na drag por 'gyur ro// nga nya gnyis dang bral ba'i na ma gang rung spangs pa'i 'khor lo zangs sam kham sa'i ga'u sor bcu drug par sbrang rtsi dang mar khu sbyar ba bcug la rkang pas mnan te/ bzlas na snod bcud kyis bsdus pa la dbang byed pa the tshom med do// gal te grub par ma gyur na/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'khor los gnad du 'bebs par byed do// sbyin sreg dang 'khor lo kha sbyor te man ngag bzhin tu spogs pas de ma thag tu 'grub par 'gyur ro// 'khor lo'i sbyor ba rigs gsum gyi sbyor bas byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ mar ngo'i bcu la rab tu gnas par bya'o// man ngag bzhin nyin mo dang mtshan mo'i sngags kyis bsrung bar bya ste/ chu la yongs su bzlas te btung bar bya'o// 'di ni lhag pa'i lha min kyang sgrub na 'grub ste snga ma bzhin no// khyad par du sa sna gsum gyi 'dag sa la bde ba rgyas byed ma'i sku legs par byas te/ 'khor lo dang ril bu la man ngag bzhin du bsgrubs nas bsgrub bya gang la byin pa dbang du 'gyur ba la the tshom med do// gsal byed nyi ma'i 'khor los snod bcud dbang du bya ba paṇḍi ta rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta sthā bī ra'i zhal snga nas dang*/ shākya'i dge slong ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'o// //// ༈ /dpal 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ratna wardhā ya/ sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i ched du snod bcud dbang du bya bar 'dod pas/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ skye bos dben pa'i sa phyogs su mtshams shin tu dam par byas nas/ tho rangs bya khwa ta'i skad mi grags pa'i dus gos dang phreng ba dmar po dang ldan pas kha nub tu phyogs te stan dmar po la padma'i skyil krung gis 'dug ste/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang skad cig gis khro bo chen po 'dod pa'i rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa cod pan tu bzhugs pa'i khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na ma ṣṭākki rā dze bhyaḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dmar po 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ dmar po las byung ba'i rin po che padma rā ga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang zla gam sgo gcig pa/ rin po che'i pha gu dang*/ drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ pu shu la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ steng thog rim par phub pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo'i mdun du rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang ri dwags la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pam̐ las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i hūm̐ yig dmar po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ snod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdus nas 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par tshur 'dus te hūm̐ yig la thim/

de 'od du zhu ba las rang nyid khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog padma rā ka ltar dmar zhing*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar 'od 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 'phyar thabs su 'dzin cing g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs su bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ de'i pang du yum bde ba rgyas byed ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar thabs su 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis yab la 'khril ba/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yab kyi thugs kar hūm̐ yig dmar po'i mthar bzla bya'i sngags kha dog dmar pos g.yon skor du bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bde ba can nas khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ gong ltar mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis oṃ badzrī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan/

de'i dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad dmar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma āḥyis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa dmar po g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de gsum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rigs gsum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha gsum la so sor thim zhing*/ de gsum yang 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med du gyur/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems kyi dbang gi phrin las thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par byon te thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi rtse mo las 'dod rgyal lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ skye 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus te sngags phreng gi ming spel la thim par bsam zhing*/ smra ba bcad/ tsandan nam padma'i phreng ba srin lag gi steng nas drangs te/ oṃ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ oṃ ku su ma ma li bhi hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badzra ku sa dzi kai bhe/ ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ oṃ gro ge ma kṛ te/ 'gro ba mang po wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ ka kā dha ya kā dha ya/ kha khā hi khā hi/ ga gārdza ya gārdza ya/ gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ tsa tsā la ya tsā la ya/ tsha tshwa da ya tshā da ya/ dza dzaṃ bha ya dzaṃ bha ya/ dzha dzha ta ya dzha ta ya/ ṭa ṭā la ya ṭā la ya/ ṭha ṭhā ka ya ṭhā ka ya/ ḍa ḍā bha ya ḍā bha ya/ ḍha ḍha ka ya ḍha ka ya/ ṇa ṇā sha ya ṇā sha ya/ ta tāṃ bha ya tāṃ bha ya/ tha tho bha ya tho bha ya/ da da ta ya da ta ya/ dha dhā ra ya dhā ra ya/ na nā sha ya nā sha ya/ pa pā ta ya pā ta ya/ pha phā ta ya phā ta ya/

ba bandha ya bandha ya/ bha bhe ta ya bhe ta ya/ ma mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ya yo ha ya yo ha ya/ ra ro ha ya ro ha ya/ la lo ba ya lo ba ya/ wa wa ha ya wa ha ya/ sha sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ ṣa ṣuṣṭi ya ṣuṣṭi ya/ sa sā dha ya sā dha ya/ ha ha na ya ha na ya/ kṣa kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya/ 'gro ba mang po wa shaṃ kṛ te ku ru hoḥ shāntiṃ ku ru/ puṣṭiṃ ku ru/ kṣa maṃ ku ru/ kṣo bhaṃ ku ru/ mā raṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ siddhi/ sarba siddhi/ pū dza agni taṃ/ bha na te mā ra ṇaṃ/ 'gro ba mang po wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pa thun re la nyer lnga re bzla/ de'ang dbang gi las sgrub pa la/ gong gi bha bhe ta ya gnyis/ ma mā ra ya gnyis dang*/ 'og gi shāntiṃ nas swā hā'i bar dor la bzla'o// thun 'jog pa na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gzhal yas khang dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam la dge ba bsngo'o// gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rin po che'i snod du zan leb zlum po gru bzhi gru gsum zla gam rnam pa brtsegs pa'i steng du gtor ma'i snying po bzhag la smug rtsis bsgyur/ mthar theb kyu dang kha zas sna tshogs kyis bskor ba zhig gam ma grub na gzhan gang rigs dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtor ma gcig bsham/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyang*/ yi dam gang byed kyi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas nub phyogs bde ba can nas oṃ ṭākki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ bris sku sogs yod na bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis gtor ma btegs te 'dod rgyal gyi phyag tu phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ ṭākki rā dza i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstshantu hūm̐/ zhes pa gsum mam lngas phul/ me tog la sogs pas mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dbang bskur pho nya'i las mdzad pa// khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni// khams gsum 'gugs pa khyod la 'dud// ces sogs gang shes kyis bstod/

mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs kyis phrin las gzhol/ gtor ma gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ gtso mo rnams sku mdog dmar mo ḍa ma ru dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum ma rus pa'i rgyan dang dar dmar po'i na bza' can/ nyi ma'i gdan la gar stabs kyis bzhugs shing 'khor rnams sku mdog sna tshogs pa gri thod dang ḍa ma ru dang mi rkang gling bu la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin pa bsam/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa mang pos bdud rtsi bcus te ḍā ki ma rnams kyi thod par blugs pa gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum la sogs pas phul/ zhing skyes yul gyi dur khrod na// mkha' 'gro chen mo rnams bzhugs pa// sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyug /gsung gi gsang sngags phyogs bcur sgrogs// thugs ni thugs rje'i ngang la gnas// sgrub pa'i phrin las ci yang mdzad// mthu dang nus pa bsam mi khyab// stobs chen khyod la gus pas bstod// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs gong ltar brjod pas de ltar bgyi'o zhes khas blangs par bsam/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ bzod par gsol la 'dod rgyal gyi bris sku yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na ḍā ki ma dang gnyis ka gshegs su gsol/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la bsngo ba dang bkra shis bya'o// khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i lha// khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po yi// sgrub thabs gsal bar bkod pa de'i// dge bas 'dod rgyal nyid gyur cig /'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs dbang gi phrin las bsgrub pa'i tshul gsal bar ston pa 'di ni dpal sa skya pa yab sras kyi gdams pa ji lta ba bzhin du btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o// dge legs mchog tu gyur cig

sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dpal 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i rjes gnang gi cho ga 'dod dgu'i snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'dod pa'i dngos grub mchog stsol ba// bla ma khro bo'i rgyal po la// btud nas de yi rjes gnang ni// phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i snye ma 'bri// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i tshes brgyad dang skar ma rgyal 'dzoms pa'i tshe/ snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su maṇḍa lar rdul tshon dmar pos zla gam dmar po sgo gcig pa'i nang du padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar lcags kyu bri ba'am tshon phung dmar po bkod la mañdzi'i steng du bzhag de'i mthar chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang*/ sgrub thabs nas bshad pa lta bu'i gtor ma bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu bzhag gzhan yang me tog dmar po'i maṇḍal sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya/ mchod pa kye rdor

kho bos byas pa'i rig byed ma'i rjes gnang gi zin bris ltar/ ltar byin gyis brlab/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bdag bskyed bsgoms la bzlas pa bya/ gzhal yas khang dang gdan rang la bsdus nas mdun gyi maṇḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dmar po zhes pa nas/ de gsum yang 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med du gyur/ ces pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin las/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor la mdun bskyed kyi tshul du bsgrub/ oṃ shrī badzra ṭākki rā dza sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i oṃ ni rī hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra nai bi te hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du paṣpe nas shabda'i bar sbyar la mchod/ mthar dharmā ra ṇi tas rol mo dbul/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci ltar rigs pas bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas bsdus gang rung kye rdor ltar bya/ spyan 'dren mi dgos/ sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma phul/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis mchod cing bstod la 'dod don gsol/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma sgrub thabs ltar phul/ thugs rgyud bskul bar dmigs la bzlas pa ji ltar rigs pa byas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa ni slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni/ slob ma kye rdo rje'am 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la gnas shing*/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don tu chos 'di don tu gnyer ba bdun tsam ji ltar 'os pa khrus byas/ phyag dang yon phul nas gus pas 'khod pa la/

me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ de la 'dir gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la mdo rgyud kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu zhig phyag tu babs pa'i nang nas mchog tu zab pa/ snyan brgyud gser chos bcu gsum gyi ya gyal/ thun mong bsgrub pas mchog zhar la 'byung ba dmar po skor gsum zhes grags pa ni/ dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsum nas gsungs pa la brten nas slob dpon chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pa dang*/ ḍombi he ru kas bkral ba'i rje btsun ma ku ru kulle'i chos skor dang*/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud la brten nas mi dbang ind+ra bhū ti dang slob dpon nag po pa la sogs pas bkral pa'i dpal tshogs kyi bdag po dmar chen gyi chos skor dang*/ yang dpal 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa'i rgyud la brten nas slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa la sogs pas bkral ba'i kag chol 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i skor dang gsum du yod cing*/ de nas rim pa bzhin tu brgyud pa'i man ngag rgyal pas lung bstan pa'i skyes bu rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po nas brgyud pa dang*/ yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan khu dbon nas bsam gtan gling pa nam mkha' bsod nams sogs la brgyud pa dang*/ dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal ba nas byang sems dkon mchog grags pa sogs la brgyud pa'i lugs srol gsum tsam yod pa las/ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras khu dbon rnams kyis mi dang mi ma yin gyi che dgu grangs las 'das pa dbang du bsdus nas rnam grol thar pa'i lam po cher dkri bar mdzad pa la brten nas rgya bod hor gsum du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs shing dri ma med pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i cha rkyen du gyur la/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos kyang bstan pa dang sems can gyi don 'ba' zhig la dgongs pa'i yi dam gyi lha 'di dag gi sgrub pa nyams bzhes las tshogs sogs mdzad pa la brten nas bstan pa spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa rmad du byung ba deng sang gi bar du dar rgyas rgyun mi chad pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can tu gyur pa la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i dmar po skor gsum gyi nang nas/

da lam 'dir khams gsum dbang du sdud par byed pa dpal 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i chos skor yin/ de la'ang rdo rje gdan pas bkral ba nas brgyud pa rje btsun ba ri lo tsā bas rgyal gyi lcags thang pa chen po la gnang*/ de'i drung du chos rje sa skya pa chen pos gsan nas 'phrang brag dmar gnyis kyi dge 'dun gyi tshogs ma dad pa dad par mdzad cing dbang du bsdus nas thub pa'i bstan pa shin tu dar bar mdzad pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i byin rlabs can 'di nyid la/ yab rkyang du sgrub pa dang*/ yum rkyang du sgrub pa dang*/ yab yum sbags te sgrub pa rnams su yod pa las/ 'dir yab yum sbags sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon tu song nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ thog mar slob dpon la sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang dngos yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang ldan pas rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon tu maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso// gsang ba'i cho ga bla na med// dbang du byed pa'i rig sngags mchog /bdag la nges par stsal du gsol// rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ zhes pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ dpal sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i yi ge las/ slob dpon rdo rje 'chang dang ni// slob ma khro bo 'dod rgyal du// rim pa bzhin tu bsgoms nas ni// zhes gsungs pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin tu mdzad par zhu/

slob dpon khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i skur gsal ba la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nyid gdul bya dbang du bsdus nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gzhug pa'i ched du khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i skur bstan pa dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus drag po mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig dmar po de las 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa/ bag chags dang bcas pa dang phung khams skye mched du snang ba thams cad sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur par mos pa mdzod/ de nyid la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ zhes brjod pas lus 'od phung du gyur pa dang bcas pa'i snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i hūm̐ dmar po/ de las zhes sogs dang*/ de 'od du zhu ba las/ khyed rang rnams khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po zhes sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i yab kyi thugs kar padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig dmar po dang bcas pa gsal lam ste yod par mos pa mdzod/ de nas slob dpon la mos gus mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed 'dod rgyal yab yum dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po yab yum bsam gyis mi khyab pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa la/ slob dpon gyis oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs lngas mchod/

zhes mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams 'dod rgyal du gsal ba la gnyis su med par thim par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas zhes sogs nas/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyis mchod cing gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sogs nas dbu brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar sogs nas/ zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ de ni rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa yin/ rjes gnang dngos la/ brgyud pa'i man ngag yod pa'i lung*// de yi blang thabs ma shes na// bsgrubs kyang dngos grub bul ba'am// yang na 'byung bar mi 'gyur gsungs// zhes 'byung bas/ bzlas pa'i sngags kyi lung blang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon 'dod pa'i rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs kar padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig dmar po'i mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar po g.yas skor du 'khod nas yod par mos pa byas/ khyed rang rnams 'dod rgyal du gsal ba'i snying gar padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig dmar po zhig gsal btab/ tsandan dmar pos byugs pa'i maṇḍa lar me tog dmar po'i tshom bu bkod nas/ sngags kyi bzlas lung zhu ba'i yon tu dmigs te maṇḍal zhig mdzad par zhu/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dmigs med thugs rje las 'khrungs pa'i// phrin las dngos grub 'byung ba'i phyir// 'dir ni rjes su gnang bar mdzod// de ltar gsol ba 'debs pa'i slob ma la slob dpon gyis spro ba dri bar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'gro ba sems can don slad du// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dmigs med thugs rje las byung ba'i// thabs kyi phrin las zab mo'i don// bden zhing bslu bar mi 'gyur ba'i// gsang chen 'di la khyod dad dam// zhes pa'i lan btab par mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

'gro ba sems can sogs nas/ gsang chen 'di la bdag dad do// lan gcig de ltar lan btab nas slob dpon la mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng kha dog dmar mo mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par mos pa byas nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du gnang bar zhu byas la sngags yongs rdzogs tshar gsum gyi rjes zlos byar gzhug de ltar byas pas dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pas sngags kyi dngos grub brtan cing nus ldan tu byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces me tog slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ bdag la ji ltar yod pa bzhin// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum la sogs pa brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis gtor ma lhar gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste bka' bsgos shing phrin las thams cad bsgrub par rjes su gnang ba byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// zhi ba'i phrin las chen po yis// nad dang gnod pa zhi bar mdzod// tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par gyis// gdul bya dbang du 'du bar gyis// bstan la gnod pa gsad par gyis// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// byin gyis brlabs kyi khro bo ni// dbang bskur pho nya'i las mdzad pa// khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po yis// 'di yi bsgrub bya sgrub par gyis// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// 'gro ba sems can gdul bya'i phyir// mkha' 'gro'i gzugs su snang mdzad de// dam tshig stong grogs mdzad gyur pa'i// mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis// 'di yi bsgrub bya sgrub par gyis// zhes slob ma re re bzhin brjod tshar ba dang*/

de ltar bka' bsgos pas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pas kyang de ltar bgyi'o zhes phrin las thams cad bsgrub par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la gtor ma sngar shul du bsgrig de nas dam tshig bsgo ba ni 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// 'gro ba sems can gdul bya'i phyir// dmigs med thugs rje las byung ba'i// thabs kyi phrin las zab mo'i don// bden zhing bslu bar mi 'gyur ba'i// gsang chen 'di ni sgrub par gyis// 'di ni mchog tu ngo mtshar che// phrin las snying po ngo mtshar can// gsang ba las kyang ches gsang nas// bsgrub la 'bad na 'grub 'gyur bas// nam yang dor bar mi bya zhing*// spel na dngos grub nyams par 'gyur// des na khyod kyis nam yang ni// spel zhing bsgrag par mi bya zhing*// snod ldan gcig la nub mi bya// zhes gsungs pas de lta bu'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos sogs/ rigs dang mthun pa'i yon dbul bya// zhes gsungs pas/ rjes gnang zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du tsandan dmar pos byugs pa'i maṇḍa lar me tog dmar po la sogs pa'i tshom bu bkod pa nyid ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma tshang ba med pas yongs su gang bar dmigs te 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas lus longs spyod thams cad kyang slob dpon la drin lan tu 'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de nas shis pa brjod cing smon lam gdab// bka' yi rgya yis gdab byas la// zhes gsung pas/ khyed rang rnams khams gsum gyi dbang phyug khro bo chen po 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i skur gyur pa la slob dpon gyis me tog gi char 'bebs shing shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pas kyang mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/

phun sum tshogs pa sogs dang*/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa'i// zhes sogs shis brjod ci ltar rigs pa bya/ de ltar na gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos dmar po skor gsum gyi nang nas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i rjes su gnang ba legs par gsan pa yin pas rang rang gis gsang ba'i tshul kyis nyams su len pa dang*/ snod min la bab col du mi ston cing*/ snod dang ldan nges pa la bka' rgyas gdab cing spel ba sogs kyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab pa 'di lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang*/ tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan cing*// 'gro kun rtag tu 'dun pa dang*// ji ltar bsam pa'i don rnams kun// chos bzhin 'grub pa nyid gyur cig /ces sogs bsngo smon bya/ tshogs kyi yo byad yod na nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ phud mdun bskyed la gtor sngags kyis 'bul/ de nas rang dang slob ma rnams kyis tshims par longs spyad pa'i lhag ma spyi ltar btang*/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su bkye'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa kha gsos la/ bsang sbyang byin brlab mdun bskyed la mchod bstod 'dod don gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par spel cing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// 'di'i bsnyen pa byed na/ 'khor lo la brten pa dang*/ ma brten pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben par tshes brgyad rgyal phur 'dzoms pa'i dus sogs dus tshes dge bar mdun tu bris sku dang mchod gtor bsham/ 'khor lo tshul bzhin bris pa gtor ma'i rgyab dang*/ tha can 'khor lo bzlas pa'i bar rkang pa'i mtheb 'og tu gnon rgyu sogs sta gon bya/

de nas mtshams dam par bcad la/ thun gsum mam bzhi'i rim pas bdag bskyed sgrub thabs ltar sngon tu 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed kyi 'khor lo rang gis bsgoms pa ltar lhar bskyed nas bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i tshul du/ thun re re bzhin sngags ring bzhi brgya re bzla/ de lta bu zhag nyer gcig tu bgyis pas chog par gsungs/ thun gnyis sam phyi thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma 'bul ba sogs spyi ltar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'khor lo'i bca' gzhi dang mdun bskyed gsal 'debs mi dgos pa ma gtogs gzhan gong bzhin no// spyir 'di'i man ngag la 'khor lo bri ba/ rab gnas/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor/ 'grub pa'i rtags/ gegs bsal ba/ spog chog sbyin sreg rlung 'khor bskor ba/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub/ dril sgrub/ las tshogs te rnam grangs bcu bzhi'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul zhib par bka' bzhi pa dpal ldan bzang pos mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub chen po nor bu gsal 'bar dang*/ sa skya pa'i dbang gi rlung 'khor sogs sbyar te brgyud ldan gyi bla ma'i zhal lung ltar rtogs par bya ba kho na'o// 'dod rgu'i dpal ster khro bo che'i// rjes gnang dpag bsam snye ma gang*// gsal bar bkod 'dis sa gsum na// phan bde'i char chen 'bebs gyur cig /ces pa'ang rje sa skya pa chen po'i gsung rab la thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mchan bu'i sgo nas gsal bar mdzad pa'i dgongs don mkhas mchog ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rjes legs par phye ba gzhir bzhag ste/ skabs su bab pa'i bsnon 'phri cung zad bcas bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bklags pas grub par bsdebs pa sarba dā shrī ye bha ba tu// ༈ /gser chos 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i brgyud 'debs srid zhi'i mchog stsol ces bya ba bzhugs so// khyab bdag rdo rje'i 'chang dbang rdo rje chos// bde ba rgyas byed ḍā ki dzai tā ri// rol pa'i rdo rje bde gshegs srung ba'i zhabs// rdo rje gdan pa gnyis la gsol ba 'debs// ba ri lo chen 'khon ston brtse ba che// rje btsun sku mched sa paṇa bsod nams 'bum// gzhon tshul tshul rgyal ngag dbang byang sems zhabs// ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal tshab che// dkon mchog 'phel dang lha mchog sangs rgyas seng*// thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' rin chen dang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang rnams la gsol ba 'debs// shes rab rgya mtsho sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// bstan 'dzin lhun grub nam mkha' bsam 'grub dang*// kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med dpal// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po yi// rab 'byams sngags kyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyis// srid zhi'i phun tshogs dbang du 'du ba dang*// mchog thun dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang brtan g.yo srid zhi kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las tshul 'di'i bka' drin thob pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa su shrī yantu// sarba dā maṅgalaṃ bhu ye tra//

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
